clue.text: Abstinence and purity have become passé in London?

indicators.note: in signals that the old verb form goes inside the name for London's financial district

parts.note: the City is the square mile of London's financial district
hast is the archaic, now passé, form of have (thou hast)

explanation.surface: A lament that sexual restraint and virtue have gone out of fashion in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'have become passé' asks for an old-fashioned form of 'have', not for a word meaning outdated; 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastity is sexual restraint combined with moral cleanness, so abstinence and purity together describe it.

clue.text: Something newsworthy about origin of transgenic ape

parts.note: copy is journalist's material that makes a good story
CA, for circa, means about

indicators.note: origin of points to the first letter of transgenic

explanation.surface: A news story about the creation of a genetically modified ape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Something newsworthy' is COPY, as in 'good copy'; CA is circa; 'origin of' gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: A copycat imitates others, and to ape is to imitate, so it names one who apes.

clue.text: Gypsum and basalt are sculpted

indicators.note: sculpted means shaped anew, so the letters are reformed

explanation.surface: Two kinds of stone are carved into art.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a fine-grained form of gypsum used for carving.

clue.text: Girl in work such as met with in chiropody

definitions.text: such as met with in chiropody

indicators.note: in puts the girl's name inside the word for work

parts.note: toil is hard work
Ena is a girl's name, a crossword regular

explanation.surface: A young woman working at a foot clinic.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiropodist treats feet, and toenails are among the things encountered there.

clue.text: Man speaking up at table to get bread browner?

definitions.meaning: a person who proposes toasts at a dinner
a kitchen appliance that browns slices of bread

explanation.definitionFit: A toaster is both one who toasts at a banquet and the appliance that browns bread.

clue.text: Take the lead and put into execution?

definitions.meaning: to take the lead is to be at the head, read as two words
to execute by cutting off the head, punning on putting a plan into execution

explanation.surface: Instructions to take charge and carry out a plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken as two words it means be in front; as one word it means decapitate, a form of execution.

clue.text: American lawyer curtailed upsurge in trade

indicators.note: in places the shortened rise inside the word for trade

parts.note: to barter is to trade goods

indicators.note: curtailed means docked of its tail, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a rise is an upsurge

explanation.surface: A US lawyer has cut back on a boom in commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: barrister is a British term, though US lawyers are admitted to the bar too. 'curtailed' docks the last letter of the upsurge word.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrister is a lawyer who pleads in court; Americans call such advocates attorneys or trial lawyers.

clue.text: Wretched time in dance — one of life's ups and downs?

definitions.text: one of life's ups and downs?

indicators.note: in puts the two pieces inside the dance

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
ill can mean wretched or poor

explanation.surface: Feeling miserable at a dance is one of life's highs and lows.
explanation.walkthrough: The ups and downs are literal: a hill's top is reached by slopes going up and down. 'in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A hilltop is a high point of the landscape, reached by climbing up and left by going down.

clue.text: Newspaper item reviewing recital

indicators.note: reviewing suggests looking over again and reworking, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece giving a review of a musical performance.
explanation.definitionFit: An article is a piece of writing in a newspaper.

clue.text: Actor entering after cue — one delivering good lines?

indicators.note: entering signals that one piece goes inside the word for an actor

parts.note: a player is an actor
coming in after one's cue is coming in late

explanation.surface: A theatre scene: an actor comes on after his cue, delivering his lines well.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'good lines' are railway track, not dialogue; 'entering' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A platelayer is a railway worker who lays and maintains track, so he delivers sound lines of rail.

clue.text: Reluctant to have husband chasing fortune

indicators.note: chasing means following behind, so the husband's letter comes after the fortune

parts.note: one's lot is one's fortune or fate

explanation.surface: Someone unwilling to let a husband pursue a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Loth is a variant spelling of loath, unwilling or reluctant.

clue.text: Typical of cleaner to pretend to be argumentative

parts.note: a char or charwoman is a cleaner, in British usage
to act is to pretend
eristic means given to argument or disputation

explanation.surface: It is just like a cleaner to put on an act of being quarrelsome.
explanation.walkthrough: CHAR is British for a hired cleaning woman. ERISTIC is a rare word for argumentative, from Greek eris, strife.
explanation.definitionFit: Characteristic of something means typical of it, an adjectival synonym.

clue.text: Gossip tart let run riot

indicators.note: to run riot is to go out of control, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A scandal-monger lets loose about a loose woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattler is a person who gossips or tells tales.

clue.text: Tackle English witticism intended for audience

parts.note: a quip is a witty remark

indicators.note: for audience means as heard by listeners, so the word is replaced by one that sounds the same

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: An English joke aimed at the crowd about fishing gear.
explanation.definitionFit: Tackle is gear or apparatus, as in fishing tackle, and equipment is a synonym.

clue.text: One who checks plug

definitions.meaning: a person who stops or checks something
a bung or cork that closes a bottle

explanation.definitionFit: A stopper both halts things and is a bung for closing a bottle neck.

clue.text: King, perhaps, heard of utter uprising. When this ends, it's war

indicators.note: heard of signals that the chess word is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: a king is one example of a chess piece

indicators.note: uprising in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to emit is to utter or give out

explanation.surface: A king hears of an uprising and ends the peace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns EMIT to TIME; 'heard of' makes PIECE into PEACE.
explanation.definitionFit: Peacetime is the period without war, so its end means war has broken out.

clue.text: Thorough judge in old-fashioned headdress

indicators.note: in places the judge inside the old headdress

parts.note: a caul was a woman's close-fitting netted cap, now historical
a ref, short for referee, is a sporting judge

explanation.surface: A meticulous judge wearing a quaint old cap.
explanation.definitionFit: Careful work is thorough, paying attention to every detail.

clue.text: Alternately giving Castilla initial capital

indicators.note: alternately signals taking every other letter, here the even ones, of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A Spanish region alternately rewarded with an early capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Alternately' takes the second, fourth and so on letters: ATLA from CASTILLA and NTA from INITIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is the capital city of the US state of Georgia.

clue.text: Put up with one's peers?

parts.note: not tolerate one's equals, but raise someone so that they join the peers, the nobility

explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble someone is to raise them to the peerage, putting them among the lords.

clue.text: One's own rank

definitions.meaning: the lowest rank of soldier in the army

explanation.definitionFit: Private means personal and also names the basic rank of an ordinary soldier.

clue.text: Nothing advanced in father's porridge

indicators.note: in puts the two pieces inside the word for father

parts.note: pa is father; the possessive marks what holds the rest
O, the round figure zero, means nothing
to advance money is to lend it, so advanced is lent

explanation.surface: Dad's porridge contains nothing new.
explanation.definitionFit: Polenta is an Italian maize porridge.

clue.text: I am one getting older and unknown paintings

parts.note: I'm is the contraction of I am
an ager is one who ages
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: An ageing artist reflects on obscure pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagery means pictures or images collectively, so it can stand for paintings.

clue.text: Give right name

definitions.meaning: to grant a right or claim to something
to give a title or name to

explanation.definitionFit: Entitle means both to grant a right and to give a book or person a title.

clue.text: Assembly unlikely to suffer from short commons?

definitions.text: Assembly unlikely to suffer from short commons?

parts.words: Assembly unlikely to suffer from short commons?
parts.note: short commons means meagre rations, but here suggests a brief House of Commons, which a famously lengthy seventeenth-century English parliament never was

explanation.definitionFit: The Long Parliament sat from 1640 to 1660, so it was the opposite of a short Commons.

clue.text: Cold-shoulder advance, concealing name

indicators.note: concealing means holding something inside, so the name goes within the advance

parts.note: a sub is an advance on wages, in British usage

explanation.surface: Someone ignores an approach while hiding their identity.
explanation.walkthrough: A SUB, short for subsistence, is British slang for an advance of pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To snub someone is to cold-shoulder or rebuff them.

clue.text: Potentially elevating saint, originally?

indicators.note: potentially says these letters could become something else when rearranged
originally points to the first letter of the word saint

explanation.surface: Something that might raise a saint at the start of his career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Potentially' rearranges ELEVATING plus S, the first letter of 'saint' given by 'originally'. The whole clue also defines: a gospel-writing evangelist is a saint who can elevate.
explanation.definitionFit: The four Evangelists, gospel writers, are all saints, and preaching is meant to uplift.

clue.text: Father or mother are not going after power

indicators.note: going after means following, so the rest comes behind the letter for power

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
NT is the contracted not, as in aren't

explanation.surface: A remark that fathers or mothers are not chasing power.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent is a father or a mother, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Wildly gay men date heartless beautiful boy

indicators.note: wildly means in disorder, so these letters are scrambled
heartless removes the middle of the word, leaving its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Gay men excitedly dating a beautiful young man without feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wildly' rearranges GAYMEN; 'heartless' leaves DE, the first and last letters of DATE.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Ganymede was a youth so beautiful that Zeus carried him off to be cupbearer.
